problem: Voice agents today talk like walkie-talkies. They go quiet while they work. They talk over you. And they can't take the next task while the first one runs.
thesis: What if your agent kept the conversation going, while the work runs? Introducing Bud WaaV Interaction Mode.
how: A small front model decides every turn of the conversation, in real time. The real work runs in the background, on any model or agent you choose. Here, Claude drives a browser, a terminal and a word processor. And before anything changes, it asks.
benefits: Open source, and self-hosted. Forty-four speech vendors, any model, any agent. On the web, in rooms, and on the phone.
end: Bud WaaV one point one, with interaction mode. Available today.
pause: And it knows when not to talk. In real conversations, it jumps into a pause as rarely as the best closed systems, while open full-duplex models talk over most of them.
bench: On Full-Duplex-Bench three, real people asking for real tasks, it starts answering sooner than every system tested.
